leds.evidence: Three LEDs (red, yellow, green) are clearly visible in a vertical row on the breadboard.

found: Resistor 1 connected to the red LED row
Resistor 2 connected to the yellow LED row
Resistor 3 connected to the green LED row
resistor_count.evidence: Three resistors are visible, each connected in series with one of the three LEDs.

led_polarity.evidence: The orientation of the LED legs is obscured by the breadboard and wiring, making it impossible to determine polarity.

button.evidence: A round blue push-button is visible on the breadboard.

button_across.evidence: The button is positioned across the central channel of the breadboard, with pins on both sides.

buzzer.evidence: A black circular buzzer is visible below the button.

gnd_other_end.evidence: The black GND wire from the Arduino is connected to the negative rail (blue line) of the breadboard.
